# Alfaz Khan Portfolio Website

> A personal portfolio and resume website showcasing my work as a Frontend Engineer specializing in React & TypeScript, featuring projects like Subreddit Analyzer with data science integration.

Key notes:
- This is a Next.js 16 application built with React 19 and Chakra UI v3
- The site includes both frontend (React/Next.js) and backend (Python FastAPI + PostgreSQL) content
- Supports dark/light themes via next-themes
- Uses Vitest for unit testing, Playwright for E2E tests

## Docs

- [Main README](README.md): Comprehensive overview of skills, experience, and projects including Subreddit Analyzer, video engineering work, and responsive web development portfolio
- [Subreddit Analyzer Project](https://subanalyzer.theonlyalfaz.com): Full-stack Reddit analysis platform with React dashboard, Python FastAPI backend, NLP pipelines, and PostgreSQL storage

## Examples

- [Project Screenshots](public/Screenshots/): Visual examples of the Subreddit Analyzer interface and other portfolio content
- [CV Download](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rkSHx0wxqKMQYcWudee8-FIxmyuQ3_o6/view?usp=sharing): Full resume available for download

**Note**: This portfolio website combines personal branding with technical showcase capabilities. The Subreddit Analyzer project demonstrates full-stack development skills including data science, while the rest of the site highlights frontend expertise in modern React and TypeScript ecosystems.
